release.releaseNotes:
Private update for Bob (Build 123 - Single-Stroke Speedometer & Cockpit Refinements).
• Single-Stroke Engine Rev: Eliminated multi-trigger bounce; single decisive throttle rev to 92% and smooth spring settle.
• Speedometer Placement: Removed header text above the speedometer for an ultra-clean hero focal dial.
• Status Directly Below Speedometer: Quota pill, live sync status, and broker alerts sit immediately under the dial.
• Independent Cards: Large latency oscilloscope waveform, technical cluster specs, topic breakdown, and retention controls.
• Pinned Bottom Dock: Permanent docked Refresh and Clean Expired actions.
